question: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 1' i.e. **'Debuchery'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelled word in the given options is 1)** DEBUCHERY.**
 
• **DEBUCHERY: **This is not a correctly spelled English word.
 
• It appears to be a misspelling of the word **"debauchery,"** which refers to excessive indulgence in sensual pleasures or morally corrupt behavior. (चरित्रहीनता)

Therefore, the **correct answer **is: **'Debuchery'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **DUBIOUS: **This is the correctly spelled word. **"Dubious"** means hesitating or doubting, not to be relied upon; suspect.(संदिग्ध)
 
• **MALIGNANT:** This is the correctly spelled word. **"Malignant" **means very dangerous or harmful, or refers to a disease, like cancer, that is likely to get worse and lead to death.(हानिकारक)
 
• **CONSCIENCE:** This is the correctly spelled word. **"Conscience" **refers to a person's moral sense of right and wrong, viewed as acting as a guide to one's behavior.(अंतरात्मा)
